page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number at the top left. A decorative running head at the top, illegible. No printed marginal notes. A handwritten annotation sits in the left margin, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: fueuerút, depromptam esse. quod uel uno argumento falsum esse constabit. Nam si extribus constitutionibus, facti, definitionis, & qualitatis, una illa tantum quæ facti est, non modò Rhetorum propria, sed etiam à Iurisconsultis alienissima est: in eam autem unam artificiosa hęc tractatio non conuenit: in reliquas duas, in quibus solis Ius ciuile uersatur, conuenit: apparet, non æquo iure, sed uel ui, uel clam, uel certè precario à Rhetoribus aliquandiu possessam, occupatamq; fuisse. Controuersia quę in Iure posita est, aut propter Iuris æqui-

page.notes: The handwritten annotation in the left margin, beside "in Iure posita est", is manuscript and not printed, so it is omitted. The running head is decorative heavy type and could not be read. The first line reads "fueuerút" as printed. "effe." is printed with a full stop. Where the scan shows "eft", I have written "est" per the long-s rule. The paragraph ends mid-word at "æqui-", and the hyphen is kept. No catchword or signature is visible.
